questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: Your silk scarf is over there. This one is ______. A. I  B. me  C. my  D. mine
solutionSteps: 得分关键：空格后无名词，必须用名词性物主代词独立作表语
迁移动作：看到空格先问"后面还有没有名词"
commonErrors: 选 my（形容词性，后面必须接名词）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: The young man often gives ______ helping hand to the old. A. a  B. an  C. the  D. /
solutionSteps: 得分关键：give a helping hand 是固定搭配；helping 以辅音音素开头
迁移动作：固定搭配整体背，不拆开判断
commonErrors: 选 an（按字母 h 误判）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: Will Alice take charge ______ the coming painting exhibition? A. for  B. with  C. of  D. from
solutionSteps: 得分关键：take charge of 固定搭配，介词不可替换
迁移动作：把 take charge of 与 be responsible for 成组记
commonErrors: 选 for（受中文"为…负责"影响）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: This detective story is ______ than the one I read last night. A. attractive  B. more attractive  C. most attractive  D. the most attractive
solutionSteps: 得分关键：看到 than 立即锁定比较级；多音节形容词用 more
迁移动作：圈出 than / the / of 等比较信号词
commonErrors: 选 the most attractive（忽略 than）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: Make sure ______ has the textbooks when the new term starts. A. nobody  B. anybody  C. somebody  D. everybody
solutionSteps: 得分关键：句意要求"每个人都拿到"，且谓语 has 为单数
迁移动作：先译句意再选代词，不要只看语法
commonErrors: 选 somebody（只看到单数谓语）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: These strawberries look ______. I’d like to buy some. A. happily  B. lovely  C. softly  D. properly
solutionSteps: 得分关键：look 是系动词，后接形容词；lovely 是形容词而非副词
迁移动作：系动词 look/sound/taste/feel 后一律形容词
commonErrors: 选 happily（见 -ly 就当副词）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: The new restaurant ______ two surveys on its food and service since June. A. is doing  B. will do  C. did  D. has done
solutionSteps: 得分关键：since + 时间点 → have/has done
迁移动作：圈出 since / for / already / yet
commonErrors: 选 did（只看到餐厅开业在六月）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: —There is an umbrella in the corner. ______ is it? —Perhaps it’s Mary’s. A. Whose  B. Who  C. When  D. Why
solutionSteps: 得分关键：答语 Mary’s 表所属，问"谁的"
迁移动作：先看答语再定疑问词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: —______ I use your glue? I’m making a kite. —No problem. Here you are. A. Should  B. Need  C. Must  D. May
solutionSteps: 得分关键：May I...? 表礼貌请求；答语 No problem 印证
迁移动作：请求许可场景优先 May / Could / Can

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: The three Chinese astronauts ______ safely from space on April 16, 2022. A. returned  B. are returning  C. have returned  D. had returned
solutionSteps: 得分关键：明确过去时间点 on April 16, 2022 → 一般过去时，不能用完成时
迁移动作：具体过去时间状语出现，排除完成时
commonErrors: 选 have returned（忽略具体过去时间）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: The young player spends four hours ______ volleyball every day. A. practise  B. practising  C. to practise  D. practised
solutionSteps: 得分关键：spend + 时间 + (in) doing 固定结构
迁移动作：把 spend / finish / enjoy / practise 归为 doing 组
commonErrors: 选 to practise（把 spend 与 want 混）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: The Internet enables farmers ______ fruits and vegetables across the country. A. sell  B. selling  C. to sell  D. sold
solutionSteps: 得分关键：enable / ask / tell / encourage 后接带 to 的不定式
迁移动作：区分 to do 组与 do 组（make/let/have）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: Have a balanced diet and exercise regularly ______ you will stay healthy. A. and  B. or  C. but  D. for
solutionSteps: 得分关键：「祈使句 + and + 将来结果」相当于 if 条件句
迁移动作：记住 "祈使句 + and = 好的结果 / + or = 坏的结果"
commonErrors: 选 or（or 表"否则"，语义相反）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: You won’t have a better view of the village ______ you reach the top of the hill. A. because  B. unless  C. when  D. if
solutionSteps: 得分关键：unless = if...not，与 won’t 构成"除非…否则不"
迁移动作：把 unless 直接替换成 if...not 再读一遍
commonErrors: 选 if（双重否定逻辑错）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: ______ exciting singing contest they had yesterday! A. What  B. How  C. What an  D. How an
solutionSteps: 得分关键：中心词是可数单数 contest，且 exciting 元音音素开头用 an
迁移动作：判断中心词：名词用 What，形副用 How
commonErrors: 选 How（忽略名词中心词）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: There are many different ______ in that small garden. (plant)
solutionSteps: 得分关键：many different 后接可数名词复数
迁移动作：先数"限定词"，再定单复数

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: Lily is reading the ______ story in the book about Chinese history. (six)
solutionSteps: 得分关键：the + 序数词 + 单数名词表"第几个"
迁移动作：看到 the + 数字 + 单数名词 → 序数词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: He learned how to make zongzi by ______ on the Dragon Boat Festival. (he)
solutionSteps: 得分关键：by oneself 表"独自"
迁移动作：by + 反身代词是固定结构
commonErrors: him（介词后虽用宾格，但语义需反身）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: These tips are ______ to improve your social skills. (use)
solutionSteps: 得分关键：be 动词后需要形容词，或 be used to do 表"被用来"
迁移动作：be + 空 → 优先形容词或过去分词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: More citizens agree to be green travelers so as to reduce air ______. (pollute)
solutionSteps: 得分关键：reduce 后接名词宾语，air pollution 固定搭配
迁移动作：动词后缺宾语 → 名词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: The journalist hoped to ______ the brave act of the fireman. (reporter)
solutionSteps: 得分关键：to 后需动词原形；reporter 是"记者"，需还原为 report"报道"
迁移动作：提示词与答案词性不同，先判断空格需要什么词性

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: With the help of his workmates, he was able to operate the machine ______. (correct)
solutionSteps: 得分关键：修饰动词 operate 用副词
迁移动作：动词后/句末修饰动作 → 副词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: If you are ______ to get lost, calm down and look for possible help. (lucky)
solutionSteps: 得分关键：迷路是"不幸"，需加 un- 前缀
迁移动作：填完一定把整句翻译一遍

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: My deskmate borrowed some books from the library at noon.（改为否定句）My deskmate ____ ____ any books...
solutionSteps: 得分关键：borrowed 是过去式，否定用 didn’t + 动词原形；some 改 any
迁移动作：先找谓语时态，再决定助动词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: The government has spent 10 million yuan improving the water quality.（对划线部分提问）____ ____ has the government spent...?
solutionSteps: 得分关键：10 million yuan 是钱数，不可数用 How much
迁移动作：划线是数量时先分类：钱/距离/时长/频率

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: Doctor Wu Mengchao saved a lot of patients’ lives.（改为被动语态）A lot of patients’ lives ____ ____ by...
solutionSteps: 得分关键：宾语变主语，复数 + 过去时 → were + done
迁移动作：被动题同时检查时态与新主语单复数

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: John is wondering how he can keep the balance...（改为简单句）John is wondering ____ ____ keep...
solutionSteps: 得分关键：宾语从句简化为"疑问词 + to do"
迁移动作：从句主语与主句主语一致时可简化

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: I had a good time in the ocean park...（保持句意基本不变）I ____ ____ in the ocean park...
solutionSteps: 得分关键：have a good time = enjoy oneself = have fun
迁移动作：同义题必须换表达，不能照抄

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: “Have you visited the National Book Expo?” Linda asked me.（改为间接引语）Linda asked me ____ I ____ visited...
solutionSteps: 得分关键：一般疑问句用 if/whether；语序陈述化；现在完成时后移为过去完成时
迁移动作：直接引语变间接引语按"语序-连接词-时态-人称"四步查

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: a meal plan, the community, make, for the aged, is trying to（连词成句）
questions.standardAnswer: The community is trying to make a meal plan for the aged.
solutionSteps: 得分关键：先找主语 the community，再找谓语 is trying to，最后补宾语与状语
迁移动作：连词成句先划主干，再放介词短语

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: The new robots help passengers with their luggage at this airport.（改为一般疑问句）____ the new robots ____ passengers...?
solutionSteps: 得分关键：主语 robots 复数、谓语 help 原形 → Do + 主语 + 动原
迁移动作：三单判断看主语，不靠近的名词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: It is about 20 kilometres from our school to the National Forest Park.（划线提问）____ ____ is it...?
solutionSteps: 得分关键：20 kilometres 是距离，用 How far
迁移动作：距离/时长/价钱/频率四组疑问词成组背

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: The research group discovered a new kind of insect last week.（被动）A new kind of insect ____ ____ by...
solutionSteps: 得分关键：last week 定过去时；新主语单数 → was + done
迁移动作：被动时态由原句时间状语决定

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: The children are discussing what they are going to do this weekend.（改简单句）...discussing ____ ____ do...
solutionSteps: 得分关键：what they are going to do → what to do
迁移动作：简化后不能再出现主语和谓语

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: Tom was so excited that he couldn’t fall asleep.（保持句意）Tom was ____ excited ____ fall asleep.
solutionSteps: 得分关键：so + adj. + that + 否定从句 = too + adj. + to do
迁移动作：看到 that 从句里是否定，才可用 too...to

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: “When will we go to the VR experience center?” I asked the tour guide.（间接引语）I asked ... ____ we ____ go...
solutionSteps: 得分关键：一般将来时后移为 would；特殊疑问句保留原疑问词
迁移动作：主句过去时，从句必须整体后移

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: the task, promised to, finish, as soon as possible, the engineer（连词成句）
questions.standardAnswer: The engineer promised to finish the task as soon as possible.
solutionSteps: 得分关键：主语 The engineer + 谓语 promised to finish + 宾语 the task + 状语
迁移动作：连词成句后数一遍词数，不能漏词
commonErrors: 漏 as soon as possible 或语序错

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: Was Jim’s grandpa good at gardening?
solutionSteps: 得分关键：Yes/No + 主语 + 助动词，不能只写 Yes
迁移动作：一般疑问句一律写完整简答

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: Why did Grandpa and Jim have to wait a few more days to plant daffodils?
questions.standardAnswer: Because they needed to get the weeds out first.
solutionSteps: 得分关键：答案需回原文定位 "We need to get the weeds out first"
迁移动作：Why 题一律 Because + 主语 + 谓语

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: What did Grandpa promise Grandma to do when they got married?
questions.standardAnswer: He promised her to plant daffodils every year.
solutionSteps: 得分关键：原文第一人称 I promised her → 转述为 He promised her
迁移动作：转述时把 I/we 换成 He/They

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: What might Jim say to Grandma? Fill in the blank with one sentence.
questions.standardAnswer: But I can do nothing about gardening without Grandpa’s help.
solutionSteps: 得分关键：后文奶奶说 "He isn’t here, but he surely has taught you..."，所以空格必须表达"爷爷不在我做不了"
迁移动作：补句题必须同时读空格前后两句
commonErrors: 写与后文不衔接的积极句

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: How did Jim welcome Grandpa home?
questions.standardAnswer: By planting daffodils in the garden.
solutionSteps: 得分关键：问方式，用 By + 动名词作答
迁移动作：How 问方式优先 By doing
commonErrors: He planted daffodils.（可接受但不如 By doing 稳）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: Why did Jim say his grandparents were good teachers? Give three reasons.
questions.standardAnswer: Because he had learned the importance of patience, hard work and care from his grandparents.
solutionSteps: 得分关键：题干写明 Give three reasons，必须给足三点；答案由全文细节概括而来
迁移动作：看到 Give two/three reasons 先列序号再写
commonErrors: 只写一条，或照抄某一句

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: 参考答案（题干见 2022 真题 D 篇）
solutionSteps: 得分关键：用完整句，不写 7 years 短语
迁移动作：数字题也要写主谓

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: 参考答案（题干见 2022 真题 D 篇）
solutionSteps: 得分关键：该题为 What 提问且答案本身是名词短语
迁移动作：按疑问词决定答语形态，别一律写长句

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: 参考答案（题干见 2022 真题 D 篇）
questions.standardAnswer: Because he misunderstood his Grandma’s words “fruit bowl” as “football”.
solutionSteps: 得分关键：写出误解的双方（fruit bowl / football）才拿满
迁移动作：因果题把"原因 + 结果"都写全

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: 参考答案（开放题，言之成理即可）
questions.standardAnswer: He might feel happy because Grandma loved his gift.
solutionSteps: 得分关键：无标准答案，但必须有 because 支撑
迁移动作：开放题按"观点 + because + 依据"写

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: (r) ____（真题答案词，原文见 2022 首字母短文）
solutionSteps: 得分关键：判断词性为名词后按语义锁定
迁移动作：填完复查名词单复数
commonErrors: 写成 reasons 单复数错

questions.subject: 英语
solutionSteps: 得分关键：需结合上下文判断是"改变"还是"零钱"
迁移动作：一词多义先代入句意

questions.subject: 英语
solutionSteps: 得分关键：主语 + 动词原形/第三人称
迁移动作：注意重读闭音节双写规则

questions.subject: 英语
solutionSteps: 得分关键：修饰全句表"仍然"
迁移动作：副词位置常在 be 后或实义动词前

questions.subject: 英语
solutionSteps: 得分关键：介词/冠词后需名词
迁移动作：先定词性再定词

questions.subject: 英语
solutionSteps: 得分关键：作宾语或介词宾语需 -ing
迁移动作：介词后动词一律 -ing

questions.subject: 英语
solutionSteps: 得分关键：系动词后或名词前用形容词
迁移动作：-ly 结尾多为副词，但需看位置

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: 给 Mr Zhang 写邮件，就"学生活动室如何使用"提出想法并说明理由（不少于 60 词）
questions.standardAnswer: 参考范文：I am writing to you to share my ideas about the use of the student activity room. I prefer to make it a heart-to-heart room...
solutionSteps: 得分关键：必须包含"想法 + 至少两条理由 + 书信格式"
迁移动作：所有上海作文题先列"必答要点编号"

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: 社区"时间管理"培训方案征求意见，写邮件给王先生：①是否参加并简述理由 ②针对方案一项内容提修改建议
questions.standardAnswer: 普通版范文见「作文抢分」页；高分要点：建议要具体到时间/对象/形式
solutionSteps: 得分关键：两问都必须回答；建议不能空泛，要落到方案中的某一项
迁移动作：题目里出现 (1)(2) 就逐条编号打勾
commonErrors: 只答"我会参加"，漏写建议（直接掉内容分）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: 给外国生 Frank 写礼物卡：①礼物名称、特色、功能 ②选择这份礼物的理由
questions.standardAnswer: 参考范文用 Chinese painting / Chinese red knot，写清外观 + 文化寓意 + 友谊
solutionSteps: 得分关键：必须有"中国元素"的具体描述，不能只说 a Chinese gift
迁移动作：文化类话题准备 3 个可复用物件（中国结/剪纸/国画）
commonErrors: 礼物名称一笔带过，大量篇幅写告别

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: 三个英语项目化小组招新（健康食物 / 音乐与学习 / Happy ending 书籍），选一组写申请信：优势 + 选择理由 + 建议
questions.standardAnswer: 高分结构：I am writing to apply for Group X → 优势+具体事例 → 理由 → 具体活动建议 → 期待
solutionSteps: 得分关键：四要点缺一不可；必须明确"只选一组"；建议要写活动形式
迁移动作：用 3 行中文提纲把四个要点编号再动笔
commonErrors: 漏写"建议"，或三组都提到

questions.subject: 英语
questions.stem: 外国友人 Jim 计划一个月读完 5 本中文小说遇困难，问 "Am I not good enough?" "Should I give up the big plan?"，回邮件回答两问并给建议
questions.standardAnswer: 要点：先共情 → 明确回答"不是能力问题" → 建议调整计划（减量/分级读物/每天固定时间）→ 鼓励
solutionSteps: 得分关键：两个疑问句必须逐一回应，不能只安慰；建议要可操作
迁移动作：回信题先数"对方问了几个问题"
commonErrors: 只写 Don’t give up，没有回答第一问
